image_description: A green cucumber hanging from a vine inside a wooden planter box. The cucumber is attached to a vertical stem with large, textured green leaves surrounding it. The background shows the interior of the wooden box and some soil/mulch.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture of the cucumber skin appears slightly smudged or painterly compared to the sharper details of the leaves, lacking the crisp micro-texture of real cucumber spines/bumps.
The connection between the cucumber and the main vine/stem is ambiguous and lacks clear structural definition. It appears to merge rather than attach via a distinct pedicel.
The lines of the wooden box show slight warping and inconsistency in perspective, particularly on the right side.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific variety and biological correctness of the fruit against ImageNet classes.
To verify the boundary sharpness between the cucumber and the leaves/background, checking for edge bleeding.
To ensure the cucumber sits correctly within the 3D space of the planter box and doesn't float.
To assess overall coherence and detect subtle generative artifacts in lighting and texture.

focus_areas: Surface texture realism of the cucumber rind
Structural integrity of the stem-to-fruit attachment
Edge definition between cucumber and overlapping leaves
Geometric consistency of the wooden planter box
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the stem attachment point; AI often fails to render the small stalk (pedicel) connecting the fruit to the vine, resulting in fusion. Also, scrutinize the cucumber's surface texture for 'waxy' or 'plastic' looks which differ from natural matte/spiny cucumber skin.
